description: We are a team of curious, creative, and ambitious young people passionate about science, technology, space, and innovation. Our goal is to explore new ideas, solve real-world problems, and create innovative solutions using science and technology. We believe that teamwork, creativity, and determination can make a difference. We are ready to learn, discover, and build a better future together!
summary:
Our project is an interactive website about NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. We created a digital museum where people can learn about old rovers, lunar vehicles, scientific instruments, and landing equipment.  
The website includes information about these objects, an interactive map, a timeline, and a quiz. Visitors can explore different space missions and discover why this equipment was left behind.  
Our goal is to show that even machines that are no longer working are an important part of space exploration history. We want to make learning about space interesting and easy for everyone.
details:
About Our Project
Our project is called "Abandoned, but Not Forgotten". It is about NASA equipment that was left behind on the Moon and Mars after different space missions.
We chose this topic because we wanted to learn more about what happens to space equipment after missions are completed. Usually, people talk about astronauts, rockets, and new discoveries, but they do not always remember the machines and instruments that helped make these discoveries possible.
What Did We Create?
We created an interactive educational website that works like a small digital museum. It helps visitors explore the history of equipment left on the Moon and Mars.
Our website has several sections:
1. Home Page
The home page introduces our project and explains its main idea. It tells visitors why old space equipment is still important.
2. The Moon
This section presents equipment left on the Moon.
We included the Apollo 11 lunar module descent stage, Lunar Roving Vehicles, and ALSEP scientific instruments. Visitors can learn what these objects were used for and how they helped astronauts and scientists.
3. Mars
This section is about NASA equipment left on Mars.
We included information about Sojourner, Opportunity, and some landing equipment from the Perseverance mission. These machines and objects played an important role in exploring Mars.
4. Interactive Map
We created an interactive map with markers representing different objects. When visitors click on a marker, information about the object appears.
The map is an educational illustration, not an exact navigation map.
5. Timeline
The timeline shows important events in space exploration from 1969 to 2021. It helps visitors understand how space technology has developed.
6. Quiz
We added a short quiz with three questions. Visitors can test their knowledge after exploring the website.
How Does It Work?
Visitors can open the website and choose different sections. They can read information about equipment, explore the interactive map, look through the timeline, and answer quiz questions.
We tried to make the website simple and easy to use.
Tools and Technologies
We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create the website. We also used AI assistance to help organize information, prepare text, and develop parts of the website.
Why Is This Project Important?
We think this project is important because space equipment is part of human history. Even if some machines are no longer working, they remind us of the missions, discoveries, and people who helped explore space.
Our project can help students and other visitors learn more about NASA missions in an interesting way.
Our Goal
Our goal is to make people more interested in space exploration and show that objects left behind on the Moon and Mars should not simply be forgotten.
We believe that every machine has a story, and every space mission leaves a legacy.
